items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: One more side with Princess White.

ctx.x: I think so. Well, I was terrible shape then. I had no business playing at all. I couldn't think, you know what I mean. I was in bad shape. And when I hurt myself, then I said, "Well, this is it."
Well, you came out one more time and did some more records with me. One more side with Princess White.
Yeah. I guess they were the worst...
